about: Mods checked in game (the user's account). exists: whether the mod is in the game; stats: 'confirmed' (max-rank values match src/data/mods.js) or 'unconfirmed'. Overrides every data source in tools/build-mods.mjs.

Cannonade.note: a search for 'cannon' shows only Semi-Rifle / Semi-Shotgun / Semi-Pistol Cannonade; Underframe lists plain Cannonade anyway

Charged Chamber.note: +40% Damage on first shot in Magazine at max; does what it says

Primed Chamber.note: +25% Damage on first shot in Magazine at rank 0, so +100% at rank 3; an oddity: a rank-3 Rare "Primed" (an old event mod), not an Expert one

Split Flights.note: +100% Multishot and -180% Accuracy per stack: +400% / -720% at 4 stacks

Primed Deadly Efficiency.note: On Reload From Empty: +220% Damage for 17s at max (rank 0: +40% for 3s)

Motus Setup.note: 100% Critical and Status Chance for 4s after landing from a Double or Bullet Jump at max (rank 0: 25% for 1s); set bonus: +33% chance to become immune to Knockdown while airborne
